meta.source: Nathan's Google Drive: forge.py — TitanForge (what Enki imports)

boards.p-core-max: affinity P-CORES, priority HIGH, io BOOST
boards.battery-saver: affinity E-CORES, priority IDLE, io LOW
boards.generic-x64: affinity ALL, priority NORMAL, io NORMAL

workon: start_workon(app) pins an app to the current board; get_profile(app) returns its optimization profile
system_role: Enki's forge: the board/workon pattern becomes Crystallis/Mechane optimization profiles — p-core-max for forge runs, battery-saver for idle.
